answer: Terrace tiers of 100 slots open per epoch: 30, 60, 120 credits. One identity locks a 70-credit bond per slot; each claim leaves a plume trace in a public log. Auditors sweep the log: two claims on one key, or one with no matching work, burns the bond. Prices climb a dune ladder, doubling per refill: 1,000 fakes pay 3,069,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-slot ring fails on a mismatched plume trace; an honest agent pays 30 once.
